name: Oaths
overview: The Scriptures reveal that oaths were solemn commitments invoking the name of the LORD, the Most High God, as seen in Abram's declaration to the king of Sodom and Abraham's command to his servant to swear by God in arranging Isaac's marriage. These oaths bound individuals to perform specific acts faithfully, underscoring the seriousness of their promises before God. The sample verses highlight the sacred nature of oaths, emphasizing reliance on God's authority rather than created things, and the clear conditions attached to such vows.
